name: feature-theater
description: Native Codex feature lanes with isolated clones, durable specs, live agent steering, and evidence-backed progress.

interface.shortDescription: Run isolated feature clones and agents from Codex.
interface.longDescription: Turn a repository into durable, isolated feature lanes. GPT-6 Astra can refine specs, coordinate work, inspect safe progress, steer active Codex agents, checkpoint context, and switch lanes without dragging every feature into one conversation. Feature Theater combines Diffmogger's work-graph discipline with Agent Diff Theater's live steering and safe event stream, entirely inside the Codex harness.
defaultPrompt: Set up Feature Theater for this repository.
Create a feature lane and refine its spec.
Show every active feature and what is next.
